description: Removes the dependency link between two tasks and recalculates the dates; downstream tasks may move earlier and the response lists the ones that moved. It removes only the link, never a task. Requires write permission.

predecessor.description: The task that comes first in the link.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

successor.description: The task that depends on the predecessor.

name: planitude_unlink_tasks
title: Remove task dependency
